cards.text: Moses, Israel's leader and the LORD's servant, has died, and the Israelites are on the plains of Moab (Deuteronomy 34:8). Now the LORD speaks to Joshua son of Nun, who was Moses' assistant.

cards.question: The LORD tells Joshua to get up, along with all the people, and cross over into the land. What do they have to cross?

cards.text: The LORD says He is giving that land to the children of Israel. GIVING, friend, not rent-to-own with a surprise payment at the end.

cards.question: True or false: The LORD says this promise of land, every place where the sole of their foot will tread, is something brand new He never promised anyone before.

cards.text: Then the LORD lays out the borders: from the wilderness and Lebanon to the great River Euphrates, all the land of the Hittites, and west as far as the Great Sea. Friend, my whole planet is just big enough for one bakery, and this is a LOT of land.

cards.question: True or false: The LORD warns Joshua that a few enemies will still be able to stand against him.
The LORD tells Joshua He will be with him just as He was with ___.

cards.text: Then the LORD says, "I will never leave you nor forsake you." Friend, I spent years in the back of a junk drawer wondering if anybody remembered me, so believe me, that line hits DIFFERENT.

cards.question: The LORD has promised to be with Joshua. Next, He gives Joshua a command for the job ahead. What is it?
Why does Joshua need to be strong and courageous?

answers.text: He will give the people the land
He will build the LORD a temple
He will judge the people's disputes

cards.text: Then the LORD says, "Above all, be strong and very courageous." VERY courageous, friend, not the kind of brave that disappears the second the boss says, "Got a minute?"

cards.question: Along with being strong and very courageous, the LORD tells Joshua to be careful to observe something. What is it?

answers.text: All the customs of the land
All the orders of the elders

cards.question: True or false: The LORD tells Joshua not to turn from the law to the right or to the left.

cards.text: Then the LORD says this Book of the Law must not depart from Joshua's mouth. Friend, I forget what I set the oven timer for before I even walk away, and this man has to keep a whole Book on his lips!

cards.question: How often does the LORD tell Joshua to meditate on the Book of the Law?
The LORD tells Joshua to meditate on the Book of the Law so he will be careful to ___ everything written in it.

cards.text: Do all that, and the LORD says Joshua will prosper and succeed in all he does. Then the LORD asks, "Have I not commanded you to be strong and courageous?"

Then He says, "Do not be afraid; do not be discouraged, for the LORD your God is with you wherever you go." Wherever, friend. That covers the riverbank, the battlefield and the 3 a.m. ceiling stare when you can't sleep.
Then Joshua commands the officers of the people. Friend, the man got the job and went STRAIGHT to the group chat.

cards.question: Joshua's officers go through the camp and tell the people to get ready, because they'll soon be crossing the Jordan. What should the people get ready?
Joshua's message says that within three days the people will cross the Jordan. Why are they crossing?

answers.text: To take possession of the land
To find water for the camp
To meet the army of Moab

cards.text: But Joshua has a separate word for the Reubenites, the Gadites and the half-tribe of Manasseh. He reminds them that Moses told them the LORD would give them rest and give them this land.
These tribes already have land, because Moses gave it to them on this side of the Jordan.

cards.question: True or false: Joshua says the wives, young children and livestock of the Reubenites, the Gadites and the half-tribe of Manasseh may stay in the land Moses gave them.
Joshua also has a job for the mighty men of valor from the Reubenites, the Gadites and the half-tribe of Manasseh. What is it?

answers.text: Cross over armed ahead of their brothers
Stay behind and guard their families
Go back and guard the land of Moab

cards.question: True or false: Joshua says the fighting men from the Reubenites, the Gadites and the half-tribe of Manasseh can go home as soon as everyone has crossed the Jordan.

cards.text: Once the LORD gives their brothers rest and their brothers possess their land, then they can go back to their own land on the east side of the Jordan. Friend, that's family: your own move is done, and you STILL show up to carry your brother's couch.

cards.question: Then Joshua gets an answer. What do those who answer him promise?

answers.text: To think it over for a while
To wait for a sign from heaven

cards.question: True or false: Those who answer Joshua promise to obey him just as they obeyed Moses.

cards.text: Then they tell Joshua, "And may the LORD your God be with you, as He was with Moses." The LORD promised Joshua that very thing at the start, and now they're wishing it for him.

cards.question: Those who answer Joshua also say what should happen to anyone who rebels against his orders. What do they say?

answers.text: They will be put to death
They will be sent out of camp
They will pay a heavy fine

cards.text: Then they finish with that line again: "Above all, be strong and courageous!" Now Joshua's hearing it in SURROUND SOUND.
And that's where we'll leave Joshua for now. Hold onto your apron, friend, because this story is just getting started.
